ctx.x: And Sarah was replaced by a girl named Ann Sawyer, a very fine vocalist. The last time I saw her, she had married and had a club in West Virginia. Ann Sawyer came in, and different guys were beginning to leave the band. So by this time, I was thoroughly convinced that I was in an entirely new and different atmosphere. My whole musical concept had changed 100 percent. And I was convinced that I needed to study and try to learn some more about what I was doing, and I realized that I couldn't do it traveling on the…
